d: Brandon and Murdock must hunt down a man to collect a large bounty. But one of them plays dirty, and the other takes revenge.

A group of thieves break into Fort Jackson and steal the payroll, killing two men in the process. Tony Garnett, a young and honourable Sergeant, is framed for the crime and sentenced to death at a court martial.

t: A Sky Full of Stars for a Roof
d: Two drifters meet and soon become travelling companions. But one of them, Tim (Gemma), is being chased by a crazed killer and his band of gunmen to settle an old score.
When, after serving a three-year sentence, Ben Bellow is released from prison, Charlie Logan is waiting for him.

Buck is the canine guardian of a camp of gold miners led by Zeb and his son Kevin. When a sadistic gang invades the camp, Buck demonstrates the wisdom of a thousand men by allowing himself to be caught!

Tequila and Bobo travel to the town of Chedron with the intention of robbing the local bank whose owner, De Koven, is trying to oust all ranchers in the area by the simple expedient of foreclosing on the mortgages his bank holds on their land.

Johnny witnesses the murder of his father, an officer accused of treason. Adopted by a sheriff, Johnny grows up with the trauma of this crime and leads a double life. The friendly and loving young man is in reality a wild outlaw.
A self-proclaimed Russian prince, a Mexican bandit and a radical Irish female journalist team up during the Mexican Revolution to find fortune and notoriety.

t: Today We Kill, Tomorrow We Die!
d: Western film starring Bud Spencer. A man released from prison for a crime he never committed sets out on the trail of the real culprit.

Bounty hunter John Marley, known as King, lends his collaboration to Major Harrington and inspector Gordon to shed light on an arms trafficking that takes place on the border between the United States and Mexico.
